title: monticalia greenmaniana
intro: Monticalia greenmaniana, commonly known as the 'Llanten de Monte', is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae), native to the Andean region of South America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Monticalia greenmaniana include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
